split: train[:10%] for training, validation[:100] for evaluation

improvement.Accuracy: +43 pts (from random chance to meaningful performance)

notes.baseline_context: 24% on a 4-choice MCQ is equivalent to random guessing (25% expected). The base model had no meaningful medical knowledge for this task format.
notes.evaluation_choice: Only accuracy is reported for MedMCQA because the task is deterministic — the model either picks the right option or it doesn't. ROUGE/BLEU/BERTScore are not meaningful for single-word or short-phrase MCQ answers.
notes.error_patterns: Common errors involved distractor options with high semantic overlap to the correct answer, and factual recall gaps on basic medical knowledge (e.g., vitamin deficiencies, anatomy functions).
